mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_type_follow WHERE username = #{username} AND type_id = #{typeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_type_follow (username, type_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{typeId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_type_follow WHERE username = #{username} AND type_id = #{typeId}
mapper.select: SELECT pt.* FROM post_type_follow f JOIN post_type pt ON pt.id = f.type_id WHERE f.username = #{username} ORDER BY pt.create_time DESC
